page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8475B processor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores running at 2.7 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is not utilized. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps. It does not feature any local SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not contain any graphics processing units, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8i.6xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
